limitations: Official pages and the 1.1.12 changelog are documentation leads, not claim-addressable runtime evidence.
The hooks page is labeled Antigravity 2.0 in the public nav while its transcript-path note distinguishes desktop (~/.gemini/antigravity) from CLI (~/.gemini/antigravity-cli).
The public GitHub repository is documentation, changelog, and examples only. The 1.1.12 tag is release provenance, not source-to-binary correspondence.
Embedded documentation strings inside the official executable are still static presence, not proof that a live session emits those records.
Print-mode slash-command answers and stream-json are a separate survey-oracle surface. They must not be merged into native-TUI evidence and must not run until the authorization gate is resolved.

identities.sharedHarnessClaim: Official overview states the CLI and desktop share one agent harness and can sync settings and export conversations. That claim is not runtime-verified here.

notes: Changelog 1.1.8 says /hooks previously wrote ~/.gemini/antigravity-cli/hooks.json and was corrected to the shared ~/.gemini/config/hooks.json.
Changelog 1.1.1 says workspace-local hooks load from <workspace>/.agents/hooks.json after the folder is trusted, and 1.1.8 says /add-dir reloads discovered customizations.
Changelog 1.0.4 says conversations moved to SQLite (.db) while hook docs still name transcript.jsonl.

hooks.io: stdin JSON / stdout JSON, camelCase field names
hooks.emptyPreToolDecision: Changelog 1.0.16 says an empty PreToolUse decision string used to crash with 'unknown pre-tool hook decision' and is now handled. Official hook docs still mark decision as required. Empty is therefore not documented as allow.
hooks.stopLoopGuard: Changelog 1.1.9 says a Stop hook that always continues is eventually ignored after a configurable number of consecutive continuations.
hooks.cwd: Official hook docs say the hook working directory is the directory containing hooks.json.

statusLine.stdin: JSON snapshot on each agent-state change
statusLine.composition: Official docs and /statusline write ~/.gemini/antigravity-cli/settings.json. There is no documented launch-scoped status-line flag. A first adapter must not mutate the user's global settings to install this rail.

resume.continueResolution: Map the launch cwd to a conversation UUID, then verify the conversation still exists before loading. Missing or deleted IDs start a fresh session.
resume.concurrentOpen: Changelog 1.1.10 adds a non-blocking banner when the same conversation is already open in another CLI instance and points at /fork.
resume.desktopImport: The picker has a separate Antigravity desktop tab that clones history into the CLI session.

settings.atomicWrite: Changelog 1.1.12 says user config is written atomically to avoid truncated files. It names config.json in that fix; the settings page names settings.json. Both names remain leads until a live file is captured.

printMode.note: Changelog 1.1.11 and 1.1.12 say those slash commands can be answered in print mode without starting an agent turn, spending quota, or leaving a conversation. Changelog 1.1.2 says print mode can still prompt for OAuth on /dev/tty. The exact 1.1.12 executable also contains 'Please sign in to view available models'. Treat this as an authorized-census oracle only.

tui.interrupt: Esc maps to cli.escape and can halt streams; Ctrl+C is interrupt then exit
tui.workspaceTrust: Getting-started docs say the first launch asks the user to trust the repository before the agent indexes files.

contradictions.documentation: Changelog 1.1.12 says the models and agents subcommands gained --output-format json|stream-json.
contradictions.artifact: Isolated `help models`, `models --help`, `help agents`, and `agents --help` on the exact darwin-arm64 1.1.12 executable do not list --output-format.
contradictions.resolution: Unresolved. Do not generate a detection or adapter contract from the changelog row.

contradictions.documentation: The settings page names ~/.gemini/antigravity-cli/settings.json. Changelog 1.1.12's atomic-write fix names config.json.
contradictions.artifact: The executable contains both settings.json and config.json as static strings.
contradictions.resolution: Unresolved. Capture the live files after authorization instead of guessing which file the adapter should observe.

contradictions.documentation: Hook and status-line docs name transcript.jsonl. Changelog 1.0.4 says SQLite became the CLI conversation format and that /resume scans .db and .db-wal.
contradictions.artifact: The executable contains transcript.jsonl, transcript_full.jsonl, and SQLite/GORM symbols.
contradictions.resolution: Treat JSONL and SQLite as distinct candidate rails until a live session shows which file is durable for the TUI adapter.

contradictions.artifact: `help update` and `update --help` exit 2 with only 'Usage of update:' and do not name flags.

authorizedSurveyBacklog: After Gate -1, prove whether `agy -p /hooks --output-format json` answers locally without authenticating, creating a conversation, or writing user config.
Prove whether an auxiliary workspace passed with --add-dir loads .agents/hooks.json before the first turn without changing cwd identity or permissions.
Capture the exact no-op stdout for each hook family, especially empty PreToolUse and Stop.
Capture transcript.jsonl / transcript_full.jsonl / SQLite file creation, identity joins, and resume/live boundaries.
Prove an auditable exact-artifact update pin. AGY_CLI_DISABLE_AUTO_UPDATE is only a static string.
Do not install a status-line command by writing the user's settings.json.
